[EN] I can't believe it... Fraya...
[ES] No lo puedo creer... Fraya...

[EN] Now that we've got the Core, the ambitions of the evil gods are put to rest.
[ES] Ahora que tenemos el Core, las ambiciones de los dioses malvados han llegado a su fin.

[EN] I'll meet you in Castanica.
[ES] Nos vemos en Castanica.
